horizontal or vertical within tolerance per a level
surface of fastener or part even with the surrounding surface

loops.name: Score and snap a drywall sheet
loops.objective: Cut a drywall sheet to a measured size with a clean edge.
loops.initial_test: Read the needed dimension on the wall with a tape.
loops.exit_predicate: The cut piece matches the measured dimension within 1/8 inch and the edge is clean.
loops.source_basis: O*NET-SOC 47-2081.00 Drywall and Ceiling Tile Installers; occupation reference only. Steps machine-drafted by Claude (claude-opus-5-5) on 2026-09-29; not observed or verified.

steps.text: Read the needed dimension on the wall with a tape.
Mark the dimension on the sheet at both ends.
Re-read the marks against the tape.
Hold a T-square on the marks and score the face paper in one steady pass.
Look: one continuous score through the paper.
Snap the sheet back along the score, then cut the back paper.
Listen for a clean crack along the whole line.
Measure the piece and look at the edge.
Rasp the edge to size or clean it up.
Measure again.
The cut piece matches the measured dimension within 1/8 inch and the edge is clean.

loops.name: Screw off a drywall sheet
loops.objective: Fasten a sheet with screws set just below the surface.
loops.initial_test: Look at the sheet against the framing: tight and aligned?
loops.exit_predicate: Screws are on spacing, each dimpled just below the face without breaking the paper, and the sheet is tight to framing.
loops.source_basis: O*NET-SOC 47-2081.00 Drywall and Ceiling Tile Installers; occupation reference only. Steps machine-drafted by Claude (claude-opus-5-5) on 2026-09-29; not observed or verified.

steps.text: Look at the sheet: tight to framing, edges on studs?
Picture stud centerlines and screw spacing (about 12 in on ceilings, 16 in on walls).
Drive a screw square to the surface with a dimpler bit or clutch.
Listen for the clutch click or the bit disengaging.
Feel: did the screw bite framing or spin free?
Look: head just below the face, paper not broken?
Look: all screws placed?
Tap proud screws in further; add a new screw 2 in away from any that broke the paper.
Look at the reset screw depth.
Back out the missed screw and relocate to the stud.
Look: missed screw out.
Screws are on spacing, each dimpled just below the face without breaking the paper, and the sheet is tight to framing.

loops.name: Embed joint tape
loops.objective: Bed paper tape in joint compound without bubbles.
loops.initial_test: Look at the joint: gap, screws set, dust off?
loops.exit_predicate: The tape is fully bedded, centered on the joint, with no bubbles, blisters, or dry spots under it.
loops.source_basis: O*NET-SOC 47-2082.00 Tapers; occupation reference only. Steps machine-drafted by Claude (claude-opus-5-5) on 2026-09-29; not observed or verified.

steps.text: Look at the joint: screws set, dust off?
Spread a full bed of compound over the joint with a 6 in knife.
Look: continuous bed with no bare spots.
Center the tape on the joint and press it in.
Look: tape centered on the joint along its length?
Wipe along the tape with the knife, squeezing compound out from under it.
Look: compound squeezed out along both edges?
Look along the tape for bubbles or dry-looking areas.
Lift the section, add compound under it, and re-wipe.
Look again.
The tape is fully bedded, centered on the joint, with no bubbles, blisters, or dry spots under it.

loops.name: Apply a feathered coat
loops.objective: Apply a fill or finish coat that tapers to nothing at its edges.
loops.initial_test: Look at the previous coat under raking light.
loops.exit_predicate: The coat is wider than the last, edges feathered to zero, and no ridges show under raking light.
loops.source_basis: O*NET-SOC 47-2082.00 Tapers; occupation reference only. Steps machine-drafted by Claude (claude-opus-5-5) on 2026-09-29; not observed or verified.

steps.text: Look at the previous coat under raking light: dry and scraped of ridges?
Knock off ridges and lumps with the knife.
Run a hand across: ridges gone?
Apply compound with a wider knife than the last coat.
Look: the coat covers past the last coat's edges with no bare spots?
Wipe with more pressure on the outer edge of the knife to feather.
Look along the edges under raking light: any lines?
The coat is wider than the last, edges feathered to zero, and no ridges show under raking light.

loops.name: Sand a finished joint
loops.objective: Sand joint compound smooth without scuffing the face paper.
loops.initial_test: Look at the dry joint under raking light.
loops.exit_predicate: The joint feels smooth and flat to a flat hand, shows no scuffed paper, and shows no shadow under raking light.
loops.source_basis: O*NET-SOC 47-2082.00 Tapers; occupation reference only. Steps machine-drafted by Claude (claude-opus-5-5) on 2026-09-29; not observed or verified.

steps.text: Look at the dry joint under raking light.
Check the compound is dry: uniform light color, no dark damp spots.
Sand with a pole or block sander using light pressure, staying on the compound.
Look for fuzzed face paper.
Run a flat hand across: smooth?
Look under raking light for shadows.
Wait for the compound to dry.
Check color again.
Stop sanding there; seal the fuzzed paper with primer and skim.
Look: sealed.
The joint feels smooth and flat to a flat hand, shows no scuffed paper, and shows no shadow under raking light.

loops.name: Patch a small hole
loops.objective: Repair a hole up to about 4 in so it disappears after paint.
loops.initial_test: Measure and look at the hole: size and loose edges.
loops.exit_predicate: The patch is flat and invisible under raking light once primed.
loops.source_basis: O*NET-SOC 47-2081.00 Drywall and Ceiling Tile Installers; occupation reference only. Steps machine-drafted by Claude (claude-opus-5-5) on 2026-09-29; not observed or verified.

steps.text: Look at the hole: size and loose paper.
Cut away loose paper and gypsum.
Look: edges firm.
Apply a self-adhesive mesh patch centered over the hole.
Look: patch covers the hole with margin.
Coat with compound, feathering past the patch edges.
Look: mesh hidden?
When dry, sand smooth.
Look under raking light: flat and invisible?
The patch is flat and invisible under raking light once primed.

loops.name: Install outside corner bead
loops.objective: Fasten metal corner bead straight and tight to an outside corner.
loops.initial_test: Look at the corner: sheets meet without protruding?
loops.exit_predicate: The bead is tight to the corner along its length, plumb, and fastened every 8-10 inches without distortion.
loops.source_basis: O*NET-SOC 47-2081.00 Drywall and Ceiling Tile Installers; occupation reference only. Steps machine-drafted by Claude (claude-opus-5-5) on 2026-09-29; not observed or verified.

steps.text: Look at the corner: sheet edges flush and not proud of the bead line?
Cut the bead to length with snips.
Hold it up: length right?
Press the bead onto the corner and fasten the top.
Hold a level on the bead nose: plumb?
Fasten both flanges every 8-10 in, alternating sides.
Press along the bead: any flex or gap?
Pull the bottom into plumb.
Check the level again.
The bead is tight to the corner along its length, plumb, and fastened every 8-10 inches without distortion.

loops.name: Mix joint compound
loops.objective: Bring compound to a smooth, workable consistency.
loops.initial_test: Look at the compound in the bucket.
loops.exit_predicate: Compound is lump-free and holds peaks that slump slightly on the knife.
loops.source_basis: O*NET-SOC 47-2082.00 Tapers; occupation reference only. Steps machine-drafted by Claude (claude-opus-5-5) on 2026-09-29; not observed or verified.

steps.text: Look at the compound: stiff, lumpy, or separated?
Recall the right consistency for the task: thinner for taping, stiffer for fill.
Add a small amount of clean water.
Look: only a little added?
Mix with a paddle mixer on low speed.
Load a knife: lumps, and does it slide or stick?
Compound is lump-free and holds peaks that slump slightly on the knife.
